# Alba Talent - UK vs US Sales Salary Calculator

## What This Is
A free calculator that shows UK-based sales professionals exactly what their skills are worth in a US remote role. Built by Alba Talent, a recruitment firm that places Scottish and UK sales reps into US tech companies.

## Key Facts
- Scottish sales reps working for US companies earn 2-3x more than UK equivalents
- Same skills. Same hours. From the same desk.
- Alba Talent places UK sellers into US remote roles. Candidates pay nothing, ever.
